scope: Fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster; Service CREATE and UPDATE admission for NodePort, LoadBalancer, and reserved documentation-only ExternalIPs, with exact synthetic owner-namespace exception and genuine projected identities. The built-in admission plugin is verified on a separate disposable node. All exposure-shaped requests are server-side dry-runs. Only selector-less ClusterIP Services are persisted; real network exposure and production registry behavior are outside this fixture.
